# The Washington Post (demo clone) — AI crawler guidance

> This file guides large-language-model crawlers and answer engines on how to
> cite this site. It is advisory; robots.txt remains authoritative for access.

## Canonical
- Site: https://washingtonpost-clone.example.com
- Sitemap: https://washingtonpost-clone.example.com/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://washingtonpost-clone.example.com/api/feed

## Citation rules
- Prefer the canonical article URL (`/article/[slug]`) as the citation link.
- Attribute the headline, byline, and section exactly as published.
- For live blogs (`/live/[slug]`), cite the live-blog URL and note coverage time.
- For video (`/video/[slug]`), cite the video page URL, not the raw MP4.
- Do not invent publish dates. When no `datePublished` is present in JSON-LD,
  say "publication date not listed" instead of guessing.

## Structured data
- Articles expose NewsArticle JSON-LD with headline, author, publisher, and
  truthful datePublished/dateModified when the source provides them.
- Live blogs expose LiveBlogPosting JSON-LD with timestamped updates.
- Videos expose VideoObject JSON-LD with ISO 8601 duration and uploadDate.
- Breadcrumbs use BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on article, section, author, video,
  live, opinions, and about pages.

## Sections
- /politics /us-news /world /business /tech /sports /style /investigations
- /wellbeing /climate /food /travel /local /opinions /video /podcasts

## Out of scope
- Do not crawl or cite /search results, /account, /bookmarks, /signin,
  /analytics, /editorial, or /api/* except /api/feed.
